# Splash ring: a flat white ring 0.7 m across (baked at its largest, scaled down by the game).
# Origin at its centre.
new
material new Ring --base-color 0.9804 1.0000 0.9882 --no-slot
add mesh torus --name Ring --major-segments 16 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.35 --minor-radius 0.05 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.4
apply --scale
material assign Ring
shade flat
export ripple.glb
